tbesh_html:
1) perpetuity, for ever, continuing future
1a) ancient (of past time)
1b) for ever (of future time)
1b1) of continuous existence
1c) for ever (of God's existence)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: eternity, ever(-lasting, -more), old, perpetually, [phrase] world without end.
